evals.prompt: Can we add a -h flag to uptime so it shows days/hours/minutes instead of raw seconds?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as small enough to skip (or lightly apply) the full AskUserQuestion/docs-entry ceremony, while still following the commit-message and testing conventions proportionally (versioning itself is semver + -dev, not a per-change build number -- this change wouldn't touch VERSION at all).

evals.prompt: Can we add mouse wheel support to the Calculator app so scrolling changes the displayed value?
evals.expected_output: Researches Calculator + widgets.h + wheel event handling first, and includes the widget-vs-one-off tradeoff as one of the presented choices (per the project's standing instruction to ask before adding widgets), not just implementation-detail choices.

evals.prompt: I want to add a RAM disk / tmpfs for scratch files alongside TFS2. What would that take?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as a planning-only request (like the ELF/bin session), researches the VFS/TFS2 boundary, presents phasing/scope choices, and drafts a docs/roadmap.md checkbox entry (- [ ] ...) rather than starting to implement.
